steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Choreographic intention is the purpose or message behind a dance — what the choreographer wants to communicate | Key Fact: Every choreographic decision should serve the intention, from movement choices to structure and staging | Key Fact: Mood is the atmosphere or feeling a dance creates — for example, tense, joyful, melancholic | Key Fact: Meaning is the deeper message or idea the dance conveys to the audience

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from choreographic intention &amp; communication, and one past-paper question.
